items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You see you were with Christopher Columbus, etc., that's '36 and Walter Johnson replaces Cutlett Cappa in '36.

ctx.x: Well, I was thinking that, yeah, you see when I came here first in '37, Smack was at the Savoy then and Sidney Cutlett Roy had gone and you had gone, Sidney Cappa. They had all gone.
Oh, Sid, I shouldn't have past him by. Well, '37 ...
You see you were with Christopher Columbus, etc., that's '36 and Walter Johnson replaces Cutlett Cappa in '36.
